While your PC shows this phone’s screen (you start that in Arnav Island, and Android asks each time), its clicks tap here, dragging swipes, its right button goes back and its typing goes into the field you’re in. Nothing on the screen is read or kept, and nothing is done when the screen isn’t being shown.

The apps playing on your PC, each with its own volume and mute, under the PC’s own volume

Controls the user’s own Windows PC from this phone through the Arnav Island app on that PC: media, volume, lock, sleep, restart, shut down, wake, find, clipboard, web pages, screenshots, its status, and anything its command bar understands. Operational patterns: - “My PC”, “my computer” and “my laptop” mean the PC chosen in the app; every function acts on it. - Use runPcCommand for any PC request that no other function covers (opening apps, timers, focus sessions, settings like dark mode). - When a reply has needsConfirmation, ask the user its message and call the same function again with confirmed = true only if they agree. Constraints: - Restart and shut down may lose unsaved work: always confirm with the user first. - The PC must be on and allow phone control; replies say plainly when it is away.
